name: qorechain-pq-light-client-v1
description: Shared test vectors for the QoreChain post-quantum light client v1 (draft). Generated by scripts/gen-vectors.mjs from fixed test seeds; the keys are public test keys. All 64-bit integers are decimal strings; all bytes are lowercase hex.
